\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 255-258 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:LA-R263-first-pass-words-from-chapters-255-258}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for for a long time and shortly.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to hold, to burst, to warm, to fill, to measure
  \item to clap, to cross, to increase, to lessen, to warn
  \item to deserve, to correct, to offer, to watch, to stroll
  \item to dream, to push, to go past, to make no sound, to dread
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To hold? (\textbf{teneō, tenēre}.) To burst? (\textbf{rumpō, rumpere}.) To warm? (\textbf{calefaciō, calefacere}.) To fill? (\textbf{impleō, implēre}.) To measure? (\textbf{mētior, mētīrī}.) To clap? (\textbf{plaudō, plaudere}.) To cross? (\textbf{trānseō, trānsīre}.) To increase? (\textbf{augeō, augēre}.) To lessen? (\textbf{minuō, minuere}.) To warn? (\textbf{moneō, monēre}.) To deserve? (\textbf{mereor, merērī}.) To correct? (\textbf{ēmendō, ēmendāre}.) To offer? (\textbf{offerō, offerre}.) To watch? (\textbf{observō, observāre}.) To stroll? (\textbf{spatior, spatiārī}.) To dream? (\textbf{somniō, somniāre}.) To push? (\textbf{pellō, pellere}.) To go past? (\textbf{praetereō, praeterīre}.) To make no sound? (\textbf{sileō, silēre}.) To dread? (\textbf{metuō, metuere}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 259-263 — a second pass}

  \item to press out, to feed, to put together, to notice, to blush
  \item to give birth to, to order, to force; to collect, to mourn, to dig
  \item trust, courage, shame, envy, boredom
  \item the next day, meanwhile, at some time, for a long time, shortly
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To pray? (\textbf{ōrō, ōrāre}.) To recommend? (\textbf{commendō, commendāre}.) To breathe? (\textbf{spīrō, spīrāre}.) To give up? (\textbf{dēsistō, dēsistere}.) To exchange? (\textbf{permūtō, permūtāre}.) To press out? (\textbf{exprimō, exprimere}.) To feed? (\textbf{alō, alere}.) To put together? (\textbf{compōnō, compōnere}.) To notice? (\textbf{animadvertō, animadvertere}.) To blush? (\textbf{ērubēscō, ērubēscere}.) To give birth to? (\textbf{gignō, gignere}.) To order? (\textbf{iubeō, iubēre}.) To force; to collect? (\textbf{cōgō, cōgere}.) To mourn? (\textbf{lūgeō, lūgēre}.) To dig? (\textbf{fodiō, fodere}.) Trust? (\textbf{fidēs, fideī}.) Courage? (\textbf{virtūs, virtūtis}.) Shame? (\textbf{pudor, pudōris}.) Envy? (\textbf{invidia, invidiae}.) Boredom? (\textbf{taedium, taediī}.) The next day? (\textbf{postrīdiē}.) Meanwhile? (\textbf{intereā}.) At some time? (\textbf{aliquandō}.) For a long time? (\textbf{diū}.) Shortly? (\textbf{brevī}.)
